title: Gol Gumbaz, Bijapur
summary: Gol Gumbaz in Bijapur (Vijayapura), Karnataka, is the 17th-century mausoleum of Sultan Muhammad Adil Shah II of the Adil Shahi dynasty. Completed in 1659 CE, the monument is celebrated for its colossal unsupported hemispherical dome, spanning nearly 38 meters in diameter across interlocking arch pendentives without central pillars, and its famed whispering gallery with remarkable acoustic properties.

uncertainty.note: The Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) dates completion to 1659 CE following the death of Muhammad Adil Shah II (reigned 1627-1657 CE); UNESCO dates Adil Shahi monuments at Bijapur from the late 15th to late 17th centuries. Standing today.
